newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki falls in vacant trade, eyes on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki falls in vacant trade, eyes on U.S. data.

text.p: Shares fell in vacant trade on Tuesday, with investors sidelined ahead of key U.S. indicators and seen remaining soft at least until the release of the May CPI, industrial production and capacity utilisation data at 1530/1230 GMT, brokers said.
"It's hard to talk about a real direction in this kind of volume," one broker said, with midday turnover around 50 million markka.
Nokia fell 1.90 markka to 363.00 in lacklustre 17 million markka volume. Brokers said Nokia was tracking its Swedish rival Ericsson lower.

Bourse newcomer Rocla started at 44.10 markka in lively trade, but then retreated to 42.50, staying just above the offering price of 42.00 in its recent IPO. But brokers said there was plenty of buying interest at these levels.

Trade in Neste was suspended pending a statement from the company at 1500/1200 GMT and a news conference at 1630/1330 GMT. Brokers said they suspected Neste could say something about its half-owned petrochemicals group Borealis, which has long been up for sale.
Interim reports from a number of small caps held no real surprises and generated only mild interest, brokers said.
